question.worked_solution:
First, we recall the results for the derivatives of the basic hyperbolic functions:

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{sinh}⁡x)=\operatorname{cosh}⁡x,\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{cosh}⁡x)=\operatorname{sinh}⁡x,\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{tanh}⁡x)={sech}^{2}⁡x
$$

Differentiating the given function using these results, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-14\operatorname{tanh}⁡x) \\  & =-14\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{tanh}⁡x) \\  & =-14{sech}^{2}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$
